# GreenGirt & SMARTci by Advanced Architectural Products

> Advanced Architectural Products (A2P) manufactures GreenGirt CMH, GreenGirt Steel, and SMARTci continuous insulation systems for high-performance building envelopes.

A2P provides composite metal hybrid (CMH) sub-framing and continuous insulation solutions for walls and roofs, serving commercial, educational, healthcare, and mixed-use projects. Their systems reduce thermal bridging, embodied carbon, and energy costs while supporting diverse cladding types including metal panels and mineral wool.

## Key Topics

- GreenGirt CMH (Composite Metal Hybrid)
- SMARTci continuous insulation system
- GreenGirt Steel Z-girt
- Thermal bridging mitigation
- Building envelope thermal efficiency
- Metal panel cladding support
- Mineral wool insulation
- LEED certification & embodied carbon
- Spray foam insulation compatibility
- Made-in-USA / Buy America compliance
- K12 school construction
- Sustainable building materials
- Energy-efficient wall systems
- Roof continuous insulation
- Advanced Architectural Products (A2P)
